environment.description: ECS Fargate container in private subnet (no IGW route) with origin accessible only through CloudFront distribution E2XKDJ9EXAMPLE. Distribution configured with custom origin header X-Origin-Verify (rotated secret via Secrets Manager). CloudFront behavior requires signed URLs using key group KG-7F2A with RSA-2048 key pair; canned policy enforces query string parameter whitelist via Lambda@Edge viewer-request function (origin-request-validator v2.3) that validates presence of required parameters before forwarding. The Lambda@Edge function specifically rejects requests where format=watermarked unless the watermark query parameter is also present and non-empty (validation rule added in commit a3f1e9b for JIRA-4421). ALB listener rule drops requests missing X-Origin-Verify header. Security group only allows inbound from CloudFront managed prefix list (com.amazonaws.global.cloudfront.origin-facing).

config.networking: Private subnet, no internet gateway, VPC endpoints for ECR/logs
config.security_group: Inbound from pl-3b927c52 (CloudFront prefix list) only on port 8080
config.lambda_at_edge: viewer-request: origin-request-validator v2.3 - enforces parameter co-occurrence rules including format=watermarked requires non-empty watermark param
config.alb_rule: Default action FIXED 403 unless X-Origin-Verify matches current secret
config.container_restart: ECS service with deployment circuit breaker, min healthy 100%
